units.name: Militia
units.description: Common folk pressed into service with pitchforks and hope.
units.lore: Farmers with pitchforks and a bell that would not stop ringing. They hold the line because the line runs through their fields.

units.name: Footman
units.description: Shielded soldier that blunts light towers on its own.
units.lore: Drilled until the shield is heavier to drop than to carry. The footman does not break; he is relieved.

units.name: Rifleman
units.description: Sharpshooter with a dwarven rifle and little protection.
units.lore: A dwarven rifle, a flask of black powder and a grudge against anything taller than him. He shoots before the sermon ends.

units.name: Siege Engine
units.description: Plated war machine that crawls forward and refuses to die.
units.lore: Iron, oak and a crew that stopped flinching years ago. It does not storm the gate; it arrives at it and waits.
